# =============================================================================
# Level-1 DMA-ingest stream: GP1 setup via the bus port (addr 04), then ALL GP0
# words via the DMA write port (addr 00) -- the 573 silicon-bug shape: a tight
# chain of GP0 0x2C textured quads whose CLUT halfword is 0x7AC0 (row 491).
# All GP0 words share time 0x200 so they stream BACK-TO-BACK (1 word/clk1x),
# dma.vhd's WORKING-state burst behavior.
# Silicon signature to look for: rec_textPalY = 0x1E0/0x1E1 instead of 0x1EB.
# =============================================================================
# GP1 reset
00000004 000000C8 00000000
# GP1 display mode
00000004 000000D4 08000001
# GP1 display enable
00000004 000000E0 03000000
# GP1 DMA direction = 2 (CPU -> GP0)
00000004 000000EC 04000002
# GP1 display start VRAM
00000004 000000F8 05000000
# GP1 horiz display range
00000004 00000104 06C00200
# GP1 vert display range
00000004 00000110 07040010
# ---- GP0 stream via DMA port: draw-environment setup then 3 quads ----------
00000000 00000200 E100000E
00000000 00000200 E2000000
00000000 00000200 E3000000
00000000 00000200 E403BD3F
00000000 00000200 E5000000
# quad 1: GP0 2C, v1=(32,32) .. v4=(96,96), clut=0x7AC0 (row 491)
00000000 00000200 2C808080
00000000 00000200 00200020
00000000 00000200 7AC00000
00000000 00000200 00200060
00000000 00000200 000E003F
00000000 00000200 00600020
00000000 00000200 00003F00
00000000 00000200 00600060
00000000 00000200 00003F3F
# quad 2: x += 0x80
00000000 00000200 2C808080
00000000 00000200 002000A0
00000000 00000200 7AC00000
00000000 00000200 002000E0
00000000 00000200 000E003F
00000000 00000200 006000A0
00000000 00000200 00003F00
00000000 00000200 006000E0
00000000 00000200 00003F3F
# quad 3: x += 0x100
00000000 00000200 2C808080
00000000 00000200 00200120
00000000 00000200 7AC00000
00000000 00000200 00200160
00000000 00000200 000E003F
00000000 00000200 00600120
00000000 00000200 00003F00
00000000 00000200 00600160
00000000 00000200 00003F3F
